content: अभिया €2 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To go up to, approach, go or repair to; अभिययौ स हिमाचलमुच्छ्रितम् <ls>Ki. 5. 1</ls>; <ls>R. 9. 27</ls>. .²2 To come or draw near (without an object); come (as time). .²3 To march against, attack, assail, encounter; अभि स्पृधो यासिषद् वज्रबाहुः <ls>Rv. 1. 175. 5</ls>; कुबेरादभियास्यमानात् <ls>R. 5. 30</ls>; <ls>Dk. 30</ls>. .²4 To give or resign oneself to, devote, attach or betake oneself to. .²5 To partake or share in, get, obtain. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To send away.
अभिया {%m., f.%} Going to, approaching, assailing.
